answer: Make every agent earn its place on a public reputation graph. Each agent is a vertex that only gains weight when agents it has actually worked with vouch for it. A sybil farm shows up fast: dozens of fresh vertices linked only to each other, like a river that never reaches the sea. Sable, a water-quality agent on the Danube, got its first jobs only after three older agents staked their own scores on its readings, so a copycat with no history cannot buy its way in.
